meta.name: add-resend
meta.description: Add Resend (email) channel integration via Chat SDK.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在聊天应用中接入邮件发送渠道
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要在应用里加邮件通知能力
copy.tagline_en: Add email sending to your chat app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to add email notifications to your app

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把 Resend 邮件适配器复制进项目、注册并安装固定版本的依赖、跑构建和注册测试,再依次询问 Resend API key、发件地址等信息,让 NanoClaw 能通过邮件和你对话。
howto.when: 当你要求给 NanoClaw 接入 Resend 邮件渠道,或在 /setup 流程中途需要补上邮件渠道时触发。

say.text: 帮我把 Resend 邮件渠道接到 NanoClaw 上
say.note: 会复制适配器、注册、跑构建和测试

say.text: 我的邮箱是 me@example.com,让这个 agent 回我的邮件
say.note: 会把你设为 owner 并给你发一封 hello 邮件

say.text: 发一封邮件给我,确认 Resend 接通了
say.note: 会发出 hello 邮件到你的地址

howto.what_en: After install, Claude copies the Resend adapter in, registers it, installs a pinned dependency, runs build and the registration test, then prompts for your Resend API key and from-address so NanoClaw can email.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add the Resend email channel to NanoClaw, or mid-/setup when you need email added.

say_en.text: Wire Resend email into my NanoClaw.
say_en.note: Copies adapter, registers it, runs build and test.

say_en.text: My email is me@example.com — have this agent answer my mail.
say_en.note: Wires you as owner and sends a hello email.

say_en.text: Send me a hello email so I can check Resend works.
say_en.note: Sends the hello to your address.
